milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task — the player must navigate near the polished granite pillar block at (3,1,2) and face it to confirm visual discovery. max_distance=5 ensures close proximity, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task — the player must navigate near the granite slab marker block at (3,1,6) and face it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has progressed past zone 1 into zone 2, facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task — the player must navigate to the far end of the corridor near the spruce pressure plates at (3,1,10) and face them. max_distance=5 ensures the player has reached zone 3, facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual observation.
